description: This file defines the ClientInterface interface for the PSR HTTP Client standard, specifying a method for sending HTTP requests.

classes.name: ClientInterface
classes.description: An interface that declares a method for sending PSR-7 HTTP requests and receiving PSR-7 HTTP responses.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a PSR-7 request and returns a PSR-7 response, potentially throwing a ClientExceptionInterface on error.
